findings.evidence: `ClassSum.lean:26` declares `noncomputable def classSum`; lines 38–44 add `[DecidableEq k]`; roadmap `CharacterTheory/README.md:206–207` says “a genuine def ... hence computable,” and `Suggested.lean:75–77` specifies only `[Semiring k] [Fintype G] [DecidableEq G]`.
findings.fix: Resolve the prerequisite mismatch in the human roadmap first, then implement the amended computable signature and connect it to the class-sum equations and centrality theorem.
findings.issue: `classSum` is `noncomputable`, while the pinned target requires the all-semiring class sum to be computable from `[Fintype G] [DecidableEq G]`; `classSumOfDecidableEq` instead adds `[DecidableEq k]`, and all subsequent theorems still concern `classSum`.

summary: The primary class-sum API still fails the roadmap’s explicit computability requirement; the added computable variant changes the required signature and is disconnected from the centrality API.
